scientific_integrity: The theorem is proved symbolically from cotangent-space additivity, a one-dimensional cotangent lemma, and Sakurai's uniqueness theorem. No finite experiment is used as an infinite proof; residual literature-access risk is disclosed.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional split local algebras only; nonsplit local and nonlocal algebras are not covered, and subextremal tensor-factorization patterns are not classified. Historical full-text coverage is incomplete for some older sources.
title: Cotangent dimension bounds tensor-factor length of split local algebras
